# Lighting and Fuse Block Installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Install color-keyed compression terminals, mount a fuse holder on twisted metal, and route wires lower to prevent water ingress. [t4]

## Tools

- Crimping tool [t4]
- Ty-raps [t4]

## Parts

- BlueSea Fuse Block 5026 [t4]
- Thomas & Betts Compression Terminal 54106 [t4]
- Thomas & Betts Compression Terminal 54138 [t4]

## Tips & gotchas

- Tighten ty-raps just enough so they do not move but are secure. [t4]
- Sand the metal frame before bolting grounds to ensure good contact. [t4]
